title: Solusek Ro
summary: Defeat Solusek Ro in his elevated chamber and claim the progression projection.
overview: Defeat Solusek Ro in his elevated chamber and claim the progression projection.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Keep the fight on the intended chamber floor.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Every six seconds of combat, Solusek checks whether he has been pulled below the chamber's allowed height.
If pulled below the height boundary, he returns to bind and clears his hate list.
Victory creates a planar projection and signals the tower's progression controller.

notes: Approval E307. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
